newsitem.title: BRAZIL: New Brazil CPMF tax now to take effect January 25.
newsitem.headline: New Brazil CPMF tax now to take effect January 25.

text.p: A new Brazilian tax on financial transactions will now take effect on January 25, a Finance Ministry spokeswoman said.
Previously the tax had been expected to be levied from January 23.
The tax will levy a 0.2 percent charge on financial transactions to raise about $400 million a month for Brazil's health service.

Finance Ministry officials began studying today the possibility of exempting stock market investors from the CPMF, as it is known by its Portuguese acronym, amid concern that the tax will turn investors away from Brazil's stock markets.
The Central Bank announced yesterday that new quarterly savings accounts opened after the tax comes into effect would be exempt from the new charge.
However, there would be no announcements today about other conditions of the tax, the spokeswoman said.
-- Caroline Bulloch, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 5074151
